# Acme Shop v2 - Order Platform

Acme Shop v2 is a made-up online store used to test the knowledge-graph builder. This overview names
the two backends that keep and report its orders.

## Modules

The Orders service is the backend that stores confirmed orders and answers questions about order
history; the operations team calls it the OMS. The Reporting service is the backend that generates
large files for staff, and older notes mention a report generator.
